title: Silent GetFontDefault fallback on font-load failure can poison the harness re-bless path with no diagnostic
detail: If the committed TTF is missing/corrupt (LFS/partial checkout), load fails silently: the app regresses to the illegible default (the reported defect), and 'harness save' blesses default-font T2 PNGs — goldens poisoned, run/CI green after. No in-code log.
recommended_fix: On !IsFontValid: eprintln + abort in the harness path (never bless a broken font). Better: embed the TTF via #load (the palette.json pattern) and rl.LoadFontFromMemory('.ttf', ...) — removes the CWD-relative runtime path entirely.
